children: Agree Realty completed an underwritten public offering of $400 million aggregate principal amount of 5.650% senior unsecured notes due 2036, yielding net proceeds of approximately $390.1 million. The notes, issued by Agree Limited Partnership and fully guaranteed by Agree Realty and certain subsidiaries, are governed by the existing indenture and a September 22, 2026 officer’s certificate, and include customary covenants and redemption features. The transaction enhances the company’s liquidity and supports its financing strategy.
